assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate arrhythmic events with neurological deficits
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated to establish a definitive diagnosis and guide management
The payer denied this service under PR-204
The clinical indication note supports medical necessity for the requested long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
